cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(uwb_embedded_core LANGUAGES C)

add_library(uwb_core STATIC uwb_core.c uwb_math.c uwb_engines.c)
target_include_directories(uwb_core PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set_target_properties(uwb_core PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES C_EXTENSIONS NO)
option(UWB_V3_ONLY "Evaluate only the methods needed by V3" OFF)
if(UWB_V3_ONLY)
    target_compile_definitions(uwb_core PRIVATE UWB_V3_ONLY=1)
endif()
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(uwb_core PRIVATE /W4 /fp:strict)
else()
    target_compile_options(uwb_core PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math)
    target_link_libraries(uwb_core PUBLIC m)
endif()

option(UWB_BUILD_HOST_REPLAY "Build the host-only golden replay executable" OFF)
if(UWB_BUILD_HOST_REPLAY)
    add_executable(uwb_replay tests/replay.c)
    target_link_libraries(uwb_replay PRIVATE uwb_core)
    set_target_properties(uwb_replay PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES C_EXTENSIONS NO)
    find_program(UWB_NODE_EXECUTABLE node)
    if(UWB_NODE_EXECUTABLE)
        enable_testing()
        add_test(NAME uwb_edge_parity COMMAND ${UWB_NODE_EXECUTABLE}
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/compare.js $<TARGET_FILE:uwb_replay>)
    endif()
endif()

option(UWB_BUILD_EXAMPLE "Build the standalone decoded-observation example" OFF)
if(UWB_BUILD_EXAMPLE)
    add_executable(uwb_minimal_example examples/minimal.c)
    target_link_libraries(uwb_minimal_example PRIVATE uwb_core)
    set_target_properties(uwb_minimal_example PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES C_EXTENSIONS NO)
    if(NOT CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
        enable_testing()
        add_test(NAME uwb_minimal_example COMMAND uwb_minimal_example)
    endif()
endif()
